AggregateContentIdentity.description:
Content identity for a compound input.

Members are sorted by member index, then path and identity fields. `sha256` hashes canonical JSON v1 of `schema_version`, `canonicalization`, and the sorted `members` array. Summary fields and the digest itself are excluded.

AggregateMemberIdentity.description: Stable member summary used in a compound-input aggregate manifest.

BoundingBox.description: A rectangle in a declared coordinate system.

CanonicalJsonVersion.description:
Canonical JSON compatibility boundary.

New algorithms require new enum variants. Changing `V1` would change payload and aggregate identities and is an incompatible change.

CanonicalPayloadIdentity.description: SHA-256 of the exact canonical JSON bytes of an authoritative payload.

CellAddress.description: A sheet cell address with explicit row and column bases.

ContentIdentity.description: Complete singular or compound content identity retained by an envelope.

CoordinateOrigin.description: Coordinate-system origin for rectangular source regions.

CoordinateUnit.description: Units used by rectangular source regions.

DecodedContentIdentity.description:
SHA-256 of decoded text's UTF-8 bytes, including replacements when lossy.

Encoding, loss state, and diagnostics are metadata outside the hashed bytes.

DerivedNodeReference.description: A reference from derived content back to the nodes and declared transforms that produced it.

DetectionCandidate.description: A ranked format candidate with all evidence retained.

rank.description: One-based rank; lower ranks are preferred.

DetectionEvidence.description: One retained reason for a ranked detection candidate.

DetectionEvidenceKind.description: Signal family that contributed to a detection candidate.

Diagnostic.description: A root-cause diagnostic with source attribution and structured causes.

cause.description: Legacy flat causes retained for v1 wire compatibility.

DiagnosticCause.description: One nested reason beneath a diagnostic's root-cause message.

DiagnosticClass.description: Stable top-level condition families shared by every parser and operation.

FormatIdentity.description: Detected parser-format name paired with an Internet media type when known.

IndexBase.description:
Whether an ordinal is counted from zero or one.

Every format component carrying a page, slide, cell, frame, token, output, member, track, or record ordinal uses this type rather than relying on an undocumented convention.

IndexRange.description: A half-open range of ordinals using one declared base.

LocationComponent.description: One location inside its immediately preceding parent component.

oneOf.description: A zero-based half-open byte range relative to the immediately preceding component, or to the source when this is the outermost component.

NetworkAccess.description: Whether a selected provider may access the network for this request.

layout_confidence.description: Provider-assigned confidence in region boundaries and layout geometry.

reading_order_confidence.description: Provider-assigned confidence in the returned region ordering.

ParserAvailability.description: Whether a ranked candidate can be interpreted by the active registry.

ProviderKind.description: Provider capabilities selectable by a parse request.

RawContentIdentity.description: SHA-256 of exactly the original input bytes, without a prefix or suffix.

RecoveryAction.description: A recovery action is guidance, never an action executed by Grist.

Severity.description: Diagnostic importance at the public API boundary.

SourceLocator.description:
An outermost-to-innermost containment chain.

Component `n` is interpreted relative to component `n - 1`. For example, `[archive_member, email_part, ooxml_part, text_range]` identifies text in an OOXML part attached to an email stored in an archive without flattening any parent coordinate system.

text.description: Source-native embedded text, provider OCR attempts, and any explicitly recorded reconciliation remain independently addressable.
